notablePrerequisites: You have at least five permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping The Core.
Repeat.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
